rows.name: subject_id
rows.description:
Subject ID
Individual ID combining study and person info, formatted '<study_id>_<person_id>' (e.g. 16_0012345). The two-digit prefix is one of the 24 BCRPP study codes 01-24 enumerated in COHORT_METADATA.study_id.
Source CORE row 3: 'Study ID + "_" + person ID (e.g.: XX_XXX)'.

rows.name: id
rows.description:
Individual ID (original from study)
Study-specific person ID as supplied by the originating cohort.

rows.name: record_date
rows.description:
Date of data/sample collection
Source coding: dd/mm/yyyy; 08/08/8000 - Missing/Unknown.
Date (dd/mm/yyyy)
Calendar date in dd/mm/yyyy format. The reserved value 08/08/8000 denotes Missing/Unknown.
The sentinel 08/08/8000 deliberately satisfies this pattern (a oneOf split would double-match), so missingness is documented here rather than enforced as a separate branch.

rows.name: qcycle
rows.description:
Questionnaire cycle (repeated measures)
Source coding: 0 - Baseline; 1+ - Follow up cycle #; 888 - Missing. Open-ended count, not a closed enum.
values: 0 = baseline; positive integer = follow-up cycle number.
Sentinel denoting a missing/unknown value in a 3-digit field (integer, decimal, or categorical).

rows.name: baseline
rows.description:
Baseline record indicator
Source coding: 0 - Record taken subsequent to baseline; 1 - Record taken at baseline.

rows.name: lastfup
rows.description:
Year of last available follow up
Year of last follow up based on (1) most recent year cancer registry was linked/checked, (2) end of cohort study period, (3) date of death, or (4) other loss to follow up.
Source coding: yyyy; 8888 - Missing/Unknown.
values: Sentinel denoting a missing/unknown value in a 4-digit field (calendar year).

rows.name: lastfup_reason
rows.description:
Reason for last follow up date
Source coding: 1 - Year of last cancer registry linkage; 2 - End of cohort study period; 3 - Death; 4 - Withdrew from cohort; 888 - Missing/Unknown.
values: Year of last cancer registry linkage
Sentinel denoting a missing/unknown value in a 3-digit field (integer, decimal, or categorical).

rows.name: Status
rows.description:
Breast cancer status
Coded 1 if the participant was diagnosed with breast cancer (invasive or in situ) prior to cohort enrollment (prevalent breast cancer) or diagnosed over cohort follow-up; otherwise 0.
Source coding: 0 - non-breast cancer case; 1 - case. No missing code defined in source. Variable name is capitalised ('Status') in the dictionary.

conditionalRules.description: Skip pattern: nonparous (parous=0) => all pregnancy/breastfeeding fields are Nonparous (777).
Skip pattern: parous with fewer than 2 full-term pregnancies => 2nd pregnancy/birth fields are N/A (666).
Skip pattern: parous with fewer than 3 full-term pregnancies => 3rd pregnancy/birth fields are N/A (666).
Skip pattern: parous with fewer than 4 full-term pregnancies => 4th pregnancy/birth fields are N/A (666).
Skip pattern: parous with fewer than 5 full-term pregnancies => 5th pregnancy/birth fields are N/A (666).
Skip pattern: parous with fewer than 6 full-term pregnancies => 6th pregnancy/birth fields are N/A (666).
Skip pattern: parous with fewer than 7 full-term pregnancies => 7th pregnancy/birth fields are N/A (666).
Skip pattern: parous with fewer than 8 full-term pregnancies => 8th pregnancy/birth fields are N/A (666).
Skip pattern: parous with fewer than 9 full-term pregnancies => 9th pregnancy/birth fields are N/A (666).
Skip pattern: parous with fewer than 10 full-term pregnancies => 10th pregnancy/birth fields are N/A (666).
Skip pattern: premenopausal (meno_status=2) => age/reason at menopause are Premenopausal/NA (777) and HRT durations are not real values (sentinel 666/777/888).
Skip pattern: never used any HRT (hrtuse=0) => total HRT duration is Never-user (777).
Skip pattern: never used E+P HRT (hrtuse_ep=0) => E+P HRT duration is Never-user (777).
Skip pattern: never used E-only HRT (hrtuse_eonly=0) => E-only HRT duration is Never-user (777).
Skip pattern: never drinker (alcohol_status=4) => alcohol init/amt/dur/stop are Nondrinker (777).
Skip pattern: current drinker (alcohol_status=1) => alcohol stop age is N/A no-stop-date (666).
Skip pattern: never smoker (smoking_status=4) => smoking init/amt/dur/stop are Nonsmoker (777).
Skip pattern: current smoker (smoking_status=1) => smoking stop age is N/A current-smoker (666).
Skip pattern: never OC user (ocuse_ever=0) => OC duration/start/stop are NA never-user (777).
Skip pattern: current OC user (ocuse_current=1) => OC stop age is Current-user (666).
Skip pattern: never other-hormonal-contraceptive user (othcontracep_ever=0) => current use is NA never-user (777).
Skip pattern: never screened (screen_ever=0) => age at first screen is Never-screened (777) and last-screen year is Never-screened (7777).
Skip pattern: no benign breast disease (BBD_history=0) => all four BBD type/year slots are NA (777 / 7777).
Skip pattern: zero BBD diagnoses (BBD_number=0) => all four BBD type/year slots are NA (777 / 7777).
Skip pattern: exactly 1 BBD diagnosis (BBD_number=1) => BBD type/year slots 2-4 are NA (777 / 7777).
Skip pattern: exactly 2 BBD diagnoses (BBD_number=2) => BBD type/year slots 3-4 are NA (777 / 7777).
Skip pattern: exactly 3 BBD diagnoses (BBD_number=3) => BBD type/year slot 4 is NA (777 / 7777).
